description: This file defines a PHP trait 'InstallerCommandHelperTrait' that provides helper methods for command-line interactions during system installation, including input validation, system checks, and user prompts.

methods.name: getRequiredField
methods.description: Prompts the user for a required input with an optional validator function.

methods.name: requiredValidator
methods.description: Validates that input is non-empty; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: databasePortValidator
methods.description: Validates that the port number is within acceptable range.

methods.name: alphanumericValidator
methods.description: Validates that input consists of only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: emailValidator
methods.description: Validates that input is a properly formatted email address.

methods.name: phoneNumberValidator
methods.description: Validates that input contains only valid phone number characters.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a command-line option has been provided and is non-empty.

methods.name: drawSystemCheckTable
methods.description: Outputs a formatted table summarizing system check results.

methods.name: startSection
methods.description: Starts a new console section with a step message.

methods.name: startStep
methods.description: Updates console section with a step message.

methods.name: completeStep
methods.description: Marks a console step as completed.

methods.name: validateStrLength
methods.description: Ensures string does not exceed maximum length.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks password strength against policies; throws exception if invalid.
